Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Define the compound set from CHEMBL122 using molecule_hierarchy to include the parent and all related salts. Join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical_smiles. Join compound_records on molregno, then docs on doc_id, then activities on record_id, then assays on assay_id, then target_dictionary on tid. Filter for target CHEMBL230 and for IC50 activities with standard_units of nM. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Do not limit the number of rows.
